title: Similar Models, Broken Odds: Where Luce's Axiom Fails in Chatbot Arena
code_status: v3 Software and Data称代码、生成回答与裁判数据将发布；未提供可核验作者源码链接。公共Arena数据不等同本方法开源。
local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.post_training.luce_similarity_audit import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42, device="cpu"))'

cost_assessment.source: Fixed v3 Sections 4--7 and Appendix B/C; https://arxiv.org/html/2610.19095v3
cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: About 1.8 million public votes, multi-split fitted models and bootstrap; eight answer models and four judges produce 138,400 judgments.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: The complete vote-processing/fitting and multi-provider generation campaign exceeds the short local/single-device budget; no API calls were attempted.
cost_assessment.decision: 完整实验成本过高不复现，审查DONE；只交付条件胜率/菜单赔率/区间审计CPU核，不拟合joint tie模型或声称跨版本收益。

summary: 发现近亲模型比较比BT分差预测更果断，分别校正非平局odds与平局倾向；原文改善以ties为主、冻结转移收益不能建立。本地只实现Eq.2/3与区间判定算术，不训练排名或制造新模型裁判结果。
